text: Mind the edge. The wind is honest; I try to be.

choices.label: Tell me about the world beyond.

text: Back from the high places! You don't look like you fell. Much.

choices.label: Tell me about the world beyond.

text: The highest island, naturally. I chart the clouds from here. Somebody has to.
A world of endless sky and drifting isles. Dragons roam the open air, and giants walk the larger isles.
The sky has no floor. Falling is the commonest death there, and the least dignified.
Nobody knows for certain. There is only the old saying:
“Those who came back from the world's end found the way home was the way in.”
Make of it what you will. I've said too much already.
They say a dragon's breath helps dragons find one another. A clever traveller might use that.
Feathers of fallen dragons are worth keeping. And don't look down. Well, look down a little.
